Hi Samir —

Thanks again for your time today. Good conversation — helpful to understand FinServCo's latency sensitivity on inference (particularly for realtime scoring) and the need to minimize per-token costs for high-throughput batch requests. Quick recap of the key items we captured: 
- Primary use case: realtime scoring for fraud detection + nightly batch embedding refreshes
- Performance SLO: p95 latency < 120ms for 512-token requests
- Data considerations: customer PII filtered pre-ingest; interested in Private offering for audit controls
- Stakeholders to bring for the demo: Product (decision maker), Engineering (infra/ML owner), Security/Compliance (if Private discussed)

Next step: propose a 30-minute demo / technical intro where we can run a short walkthrough of Redwood's runtime, discuss model/quantization options, and map to your infra constraints. Here are 3 options (all PT):

- Thu, Mar 5 — 11:00–11:30 AM PT
- Fri, Mar 6 — 09:00–09:30 AM PT
- Mon, Mar 9 — 01:00–01:30 PM PT

Can you confirm which slot works best and who will join from your side? If none of these fit, send 2–3 times that do and we'll align. I've attached the discovery notes from today for reference (Discovery-notes-20260301.pdf).

Attaching a tentative agenda: quick recap (5m), demo (15m), Q&A and next steps (10m). I'll loop in Jonas (cc'd) — he'll lead the demo/technical deep dive.

Thanks — look forward to locking this in.

Best,
